5.2 Network Training

A simple approach to the problem of determining the network parameters is to make an analogy with the discussion of polynomial curve fitting, and therefore to minimize a sum-of-squares error function. Given a training set comprising a set of input vectors \(\{X_n\}\), where \(n=1,2,...,N\) with the corresponding output set as \(\{t_n\}\), we minimize the error function

\[\begin{align} E(W) = \frac{1}{2}\sum_{n=1}^{N}||y_n(X_n,W) - t_n||^2 \end{align}\]
